readings: For each film in the inventory, show its `film_id`, its number of copies (inventory records), and its share of all inventory copies (its copy count divided by the total number of copies across all films, unrounded). Sort from highest share to lowest and return the top 10 films, plus every other film whose copy count equals that of the 10th film, so no film tied at the cutoff is left out.
queries:
WITH counts AS (
  SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) AS copies
  FROM inventory
  GROUP BY film_id
),
total AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_copies FROM inventory
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT c.film_id, c.copies, CAST(c.copies AS REAL) / t.total_copies AS share
  FROM counts c, total t
),
cutoff AS (
  SELECT copies AS cutoff_copies
  FROM ranked
  ORDER BY share DESC
  LIMIT 1 OFFSET 9
)
SELECT film_id, copies, share
FROM ranked
WHERE copies >= (SELECT cutoff_copies FROM cutoff)
ORDER BY share DESC;
